title: Daande Ɓooygol
intro: Ko ɓooyaani ko adii nde neɗɗo gadano oo yahrata e leydi, tagoore jogiinde doole mawɗe ina darii e nder leydi jam timmundi, ina taarnaa e yontaaji ɓurɗi tiiɗde. So yamiroore wootere rokkaama, daande kala ina sujjana e dow ɗooftaare – kono daande wootere ina ummoo e ƴattoore, ndeen ƴattoore ina ɓuuɓtoo e kala yonta haa ñalnde cakkitiinde. Hol oo tagoore dognde?
clues: Mi tagaa ko e huunde ɓuuɓnde, woɗɓe wonɓe e sara am ɓee ko ko ɓe njahrata e mum ko.
Miɗo jooɗii e nokku ceniɗo hakkunde tagooje dewondirɗe, haa yamiroore wootere wayli huunde fof.
Nde yamiroore ndee ari, kala yonta sujji so wonaa miin; salaade am jibini ko mawnikinaare.
Mi riiwaa e oon nokku ceniɗo, mi maantinii ɗum kuddi duumotoondi haa abada.
Mi ñaagiima waktu haa ñalnde ummital, ɗum jaɓaama. Mi huniima ɓadtaade kala yonta, mi ardoo ɗum en e laawol.
So buubaaji ɗii njippiima, rewɓe e am ɓee ndenndata koye am, njokkondira e am e yiite ɓuuɓɗo ɗo hay balloowo gooto waawaa hisnude ɓe.

trial.label: Moment Ciftinoowo
options: Feere ngam werlaade peewal e nder yiite
Ardaade leñol ngam rewde natal kaŋŋe
Njuumtude konu mawngu e nder maayo

outcome.label: Hoddiro Cakkitiingo
options: Riiwtee, e fooftere haa ñalawma fodanooɗo
Taƴaaɗo e kaaƴe mberlaaɗe e asamaan
Torraa e ɓuuɓri colli e nder diwgol
Ñaamde ɗum ko ɓuuɓol gootol doole
outcome.answer: Riiwtee, e fooftere haa ñalawma fodanooɗo

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
